Who is Declan Akaba?

Declan Akaba, known as Reiji Akaba in the Japanese version, is a character in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force series. This is a video game depiction of Declan Akaba, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V anime.
